about_the_game:
Do you believe in curses?

An invitation from the Ignis Hotel shatters Allen's peace...

Behind every door lies a completely different world...

A puppet singing theater lullabies,

Scattered limbs in a circus,

A human-shaped ice sculpture splattered with paint in the snow-covered forest...

Countless fragmented cases are piecing together a shocking conspiracy connected to Allen!

The game boasts a complete and logically sound storyline, divided into six interconnected and progressively unfolding chapters. Each chapter is intricately plotted, with foreshadowing and unexpected twists that gradually propel the main story forward. From a fog-shrouded beginning to a complex web of clues and intricate plot developments, the game ultimately unveils the ultimate truth, maintaining a fast-paced and engaging narrative. A complete playthrough takes approximately 12 hours. Each chapter features its own unique world, core puzzles, and subplots, with a well-balanced difficulty level that caters to both casual players seeking an immersive cinematic experience and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts seeking deductive reasoning.

The game utilizes a unique American oil painting style to create cinematic, immersive environments, crafting a mysterious, oppressive, and atmospheric suspense world. The retro, dark color palette, the hand-drawn details concealing clues, and the atmosphere perfectly complementing the plot's twists and turns ensure that every exploration is filled with the unknown and mystery. This game abandons meaningless filler puzzles; all mechanism solving, clue gathering, and logical reasoning are deeply integrated with the main storyline. Players must piece together fragmented clues, solve scene-specific mechanisms, and gradually peel back layers of fog to uncover the lies and secrets hidden beneath the surface.

A journey to uncover the truth, exclusively for you, has begun. Through repeated interactions with the scenes, you await to unravel the long-forgotten mysteries of time and space...
